d:
Why do ceiling fans get so dirty even though they spin all the time? You'd think the spinning motion would fling dust away — but it actually makes things worse! In this video, we explain the surprising science behind why ceiling fans are dust magnets, using concepts from electromagnetism and fluid dynamics.
From dead skin cells and pet dander floating in your home to static electricity on plastic blades and the boundary layer effect from fluid dynamics — we cover it all in simple words.
Topics Covered:
• What household dust is really made of
